profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer | Data Engineer | Azure Developer
profile.summary: I’m a solutions-oriented full-stack developer and data engineer who loves transforming complex requirements and challenges into scalable, impactful solutions. Whether I’m designing ETL pipelines in the cloud or creating user-friendly applications, my priority is to deliver value that helps teams make better, data-driven decisions. I thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy continuously exploring new technologies to keep my skills sharp.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
In my role as Lead Software Developer, I’ve been guiding my development team, shaping our processes with a Scrum approach, and partnering with stakeholders to automate manual workflows. My focus is on delivering quick-turnaround solutions that drive immediate impact, while also laying the groundwork for larger, long-term initiatives

- Automation Initiatives: Eliminated ~20 weekly hours of manual claim-payment work and reduced daily refund-processing time by streamlining workflows and automating key steps.
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Held solution-focused sessions that turned manual processes into efficient automated systems, aligning performance goals with business needs.
- Team alignment: Collaborated on creating user stories and refined sprint objectives, ensuring the team delivered impactful features on schedule.
- Code Quality & Best Practices: Improved release quality and maintainability by establishing a code review process and mentoring the team in clean, reusable coding standards.
positions.insights: Team Leadership, Data Integration and +15 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
After stepping up from my Junior Developer role, I took on a Software Developer position at Orion180. I focused on designing scalable data solutions, automating processes, and making life easier for the teams that relied on my work. Seeing our workflows become smoother and more efficient was the best part of the job!

Key Contributions

- Enabled broader data access and contributed to a 50% YOY revenue growth by designing and implementing an ETL pipeline (Azure Data Factory, Functions, Blob Storage, Key Vault) in collaboration with multiple teams.
- Cut the financial import process time by 90%, saving the finance team 4–5 hours daily, by re-architecting workflows and introducing C# and SQL logic to automate manual processes.
- Reduced bugs by 50% and established a failover mechanism for two BI teams (10 people total) by implementing reliable Git-based version control and setting up multiple environments for Power BI development.
- Reduced manual reporting errors by 99% and enabled seamless partner integration by creating a suite of reports using Vue.js, C#, and SQL, tailored to new product requirements.
positions.insights: Visual Studio, Data Integration and +20 skills

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Junior Developer at Orion180, I got to combine my passion for problem-solving with technology. I loved making data more accessible and useful for our teams, whether that was through efficient SQL queries or intuitive, data-driven Power Bi dashboards.

Key Contributions

- Improved data reporting and query performance using SQL, aligning with evolving business needs
- Built and customized Power BI dashboards to guide faster, more informed decision-making
- Reduced reporting infrastructure response times by up to 50% through front-end optimizations
- Maintained proactive communication with the tech lead and stakeholders, ensuring quick issue resolution and smooth collaboration on my tickets
positions.insights: Data Integration, Data Warehousing and +17 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Led the development of interactive, user-friendly web interfaces using JavaScript and HTML5, which significantly enhanced user engagement and satisfaction. I streamlined the development stack by introducing new practices, resulting in a 30% reduction in time-to-market for new features. Additionally, I optimized code performance, achieving a 50% reduction in application load times, thereby improving both user satisfaction and overall business efficiency.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.insights: Visual Studio, Microsoft Office and +5 skills
